ops.title: Flaky under full suite: test_invalid_recovered_cost_aborts_before_wall_cancel_sidecar (research loop wall-timing)
ops.description: Observed 2026-07-19 in a jj-workspace venv (.venv-w4, dev extras, Python 3.14t) while landing the Tinker price-sheet refresh (282a037): the test FAILED in one full 'uv run pytest' run, then passed in the next full run and 9/9 consecutive isolated runs. Suite-context-only flake — likely wall-clock sensitivity under parallel suite load on a host whose load baseline is ~5-6 (the 0.9.0 fix arc already 'deliberately widened' wall-timing tests when preflight moved inside the wall reservation; this one appears to still carry a tight margin). Not price-related (fails/passes across identical code). Repro attempt: full suite vs isolated; no seed involved. Suggested fix direction: widen or fake the wall clock in this test rather than racing real time.

ops.text: root cause identified; test made load-immune (fake/widened wall clock) or documented margin justified; 3 consecutive full-suite runs green under load
